# Lab 28.3: GenAI Customer Review Intelligence

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn raw customer reviews into business intelligence: classify and score them with AI functions, make them searchable with autonomous embeddings, and publish a data agent for business users.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create the review table with an autonomous embedding column (Lab 14.4).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS cap3 OPTIONS (location = 'US');
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE cap3.reviews (
  review_id INT64, title STRING, review STRING,
  review_embedding STRUCT&lt;result ARRAY&lt;FLOAT64&gt;, status STRING&gt;
    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (AI.EMBED(review, model =&gt; 'embeddinggemma-300m')) STORED OPTIONS (asynchronous = TRUE)
);
INSERT INTO cap3.reviews (review_id, title, review)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (), title, review
FROM `bigquery-public-data.imdb.reviews` WHERE review IS NOT NULL LIMIT 500;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Enrich with managed AI functions (Lab 13.5).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE cap3.reviews_enriched AS
SELECT review_id, title, review,
  AI.CLASSIFY(review, categories =&gt; ['acting', 'story', 'visuals', 'music', 'pacing']) AS main_topic,
  AI.SCORE(('Rate how positive this review is from 1 to 10: ', review)) AS positivity
FROM cap3.reviews;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Summaries per topic (Lab 13.6).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT main_topic, COUNT(*) AS reviews, ROUND(AVG(positivity), 1) AS avg_positivity,
  AI.AGG(review, 'Summarise the main complaints and praises in 3 bullet points.') AS summary
FROM cap3.reviews_enriched GROUP BY main_topic;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Semantic search (Lab 14.4).**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT base.title, base.review, distance
FROM AI.SEARCH(TABLE cap3.reviews, 'review', 'beautiful soundtrack but boring middle part', top_k =&gt; 5);</span>

5. **[Console] Publish a data agent (Lab 16.3).** Create `review_insights_agent` with sources `cap3.reviews_enriched`, instructions defining *positivity* and *topic*, and a verified query for "average positivity by topic". Publish it and share it with a business user.

6. **Review.** Estimate the token cost with `AI.COUNT_TOKENS` (Lab 13.12) for 1 million reviews, and decide which steps should be precomputed vs run on demand.
